chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb narrated from Zurārah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

The compensation (mutʿah) for women is obligatory, whether consummation took place with her or consummation did not take place with her, and she is to be provided this compensation before she is divorced.

key_terms.النِّسَاءِ: women, specifically wives in the context of divorce
key_terms.تُمَتَّعُ: she is to be given compensatory provision
key_terms.دُخِلَ بِهَا: the marriage was consummated with her
key_terms.مُتْعَةُ: compensatory provision or gift due to the woman upon divorce

ai.seo_question: Is mutʿah compensation for a divorced woman obligatory even if the marriage was not consummated?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that a divorced woman is entitled to mutʿah, meaning compensatory provision, regardless of whether the marriage was consummated. It also specifies that this provision should be given before the divorce is carried out.
